intro: At the freshly dug dirt where Narain Soothfancy's book should lie, a ransom note has been left in its place. You carry the letter back to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. This follows Draconic for Dummies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.
We've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask.
Bring the money and come alone!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Booknap my... Book, will they!? I'll teach them what it means to mess with a psychic gnome!
